name: Jordan Rivera
title: Product Analyst  |  Experimentation & Retention Analytics
summary: Product analyst with three years at a subscription app: designed and analysed 40+ A/B tests (30+ shipped) and built the dbt KPI layer 5 teams use as their single source of truth. Automated the weekly KPI report, cutting preparation from ~6 hours to ~45 minutes. MSc in Business Analytics; works in SQL, dbt and Python.

experience.title: Product Analyst
bullets: Designed and analysed 40+ A/B tests on onboarding, paywall and notification flows, from hypothesis and power analysis to a ship/no-ship recommendation; 30+ shipped.
Built a SQL + dbt KPI layer (activation, retention, revenue) used by 5 product and marketing teams as their single source of truth.
Automated the weekly KPI report with Python and scheduled dbt runs, cutting preparation from ~6 hours to ~45 minutes.
Built a churn-prediction model (logistic regression) that ranked at-risk subscribers and improved save-offer targeting.
Defined the event tracking plan for the new onboarding flow with engineering: 18 events and their properties.

experience.title: Data Analyst Intern
bullets: Cleaned and reconciled 2 years of store sales data in Excel and SQL for the pricing team.
Built a weekly Tableau dashboard of promotion performance for 4 category managers.

skills.label: Analytics & Methods
skills.items: A/B testing & power analysis, KPI modelling, churn prediction (logistic regression, gradient boosting), event tracking plans, stakeholder reporting.
